purpose: Vertical mobile ground for the homepage hero, generated separately rather than cropped from the 16:9
prompt:
A wide cinematic atmospheric background for a dark web hero section. Deep blue-black ground (#070A12 to #0D1220) filling most of the frame, with a warm amber light source (#F5A524 to #FFC15C) glowing from the upper right and falling away into darkness toward the lower left. Soft volumetric haze, gentle bokeh particles suspended in the air, subtle lens diffusion. The left third of the frame stays deep and uncluttered so white typography can sit over it. Restrained saturation, warm highlights against blue-black shadows, film-grade tonality with detail retained in the shadows. Non-representational, purely atmospheric light and colour.

Vertical mobile composition of a cinematic stage-light background. Warm amber theatrical beams raking down from the upper right through dark haze against a deep blue-black ground. The UPPER THIRD of the frame stays deep, dark and low-detail so white headline type can sit over it; the light gathers in the lower two-thirds. Absolutely no people, no words and no logos.

Absolute constraints: No people, no human figures, no faces, no hands, no silhouettes of people, no crowds. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no captions, no watermarks, no signatures. No logos, no brand marks, no institutional signage. Nothing that could be mistaken for a documentary photograph of a real school, classroom, studio, rehearsal, performance, award ceremony or event. Purely abstract, atmospheric and decorative.
